messages:
Alya: Sam from Acme Data hit us — rerank calls are either returning a 400 about embedding dims or returning flat/identical scores for the top candidates. he pasted his flow and sample payloads.

Sam (Acme Data): we re-used stored vectors produced months ago, we don't want to re-embed millions. sometimes rerank returns 400 'Embedding dimension mismatch', other times it completes but all scores are ~0.0008 the same. also seeing latency spikes and a handful of 429s when batching.

Alya: their embed model when vectors were generated: "embed-concise-1536-v1". the rerank model they call now: "rerank-quick-768-v2". payloads below (anonymized).

Alya: embedding call they originally ran:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-concise-1536-v1","input":"Example snippet"}'
```
response (trimmed):
```
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.0009,-0.12, ... ,0.003], "model":"embed-concise-1536-v1", "dim":1536}]}
```

Alya: rerank call they now send (simplified):
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"rerank-quick-768-v2",
    "query_embedding":[...1536 numbers...],
    "candidate_embeddings":[[...1536...],[...1536...]]
  }'
```

Josh: root cause is almost certainly mismatch between embedding output dim (1536) and rerank expected dim (768). two failure modes we've seen:
- strict validation path: we return 400 with message like "Embedding dimension mismatch: provided 1536, expected 768" (this is happening for some requests)
- permissive path: server accepts the vector and implicitly truncates/zero-pads or projects it in a generic way, which often yields meaningless / near-identical scores (this matches the flat scores report)

Kai: triage checklist to send to customer:
- confirm exact model strings and versions used when vectors were created (embed-concise-1536-v1) and for rerank (rerank-quick-768-v2).
- in their DB, pull a sample vector and check length: e.g., len(data[0]["embedding"]) == 1536.
- reproduce locally: call embeddings endpoint for the same input and confirm dim.
- fetch rerank model metadata from internal registry (I'll check, but rerank-quick-768-v2 expects embedding_dim=768).
- ask for request_id and the full request/response JSON for both the embedding call and the failing rerank call.
- capture X-RateLimit headers and any 429/Retry-After values.

Alya: I ran a local repro: confirmed embed call returns 1536 dim. rerank returns 400 when we send 1536-length vectors. when I forced the server to accept via our staging flag it completed but produced a uniform score vector.

Devon: mitigation options for customer (prioritized):
1) re-embed candidates & queries with a rerank-compatible embedding model (recommended). re-embedding is the highest-fidelity fix.
2) if re-embedding millions isn't possible, perform an offline projection (1536 -> 768) using a learned linear map or PCA. warn: this reduces quality and may introduce bias.
3) small stopgap: validate dims client-side and reject requests early. sample snippet below.

Alya: sample validation snippet (Python):
```
# validate dims before sending to /v1/rerank
def validate_dims(vec, expected_dim):
    if len(vec) != expected_dim:
        raise ValueError(f"embedding dim {len(vec)} != expected {expected_dim}")

# usage
expected = 768
validate_dims(query_embedding, expected)
for c in candidate_embeddings:
    validate_dims(c, expected)
```

Kai: sample naive projection approach (customer-facing pseudo):
```
import numpy as np
# vec: 1536-d vector from store
# W: 768 x 1536 projection matrix (e.g., from PCA or trained linear layer)
vec_1536 = np.array(vec)
vec_768 = W.dot(vec_1536)
# then send vec_768 to rerank\````
Note: we cannot supply a recommended projection matrix; quality varies. suggest customer runs small eval to compare repro.

Devon: billing/ops notes — adding to triage: if they choose to re-embed, that will incur embedding API charges at time of re-run; rerank calls are billed separately per call. I'll loop in billing to confirm whether their historical embedding charges look correct and to advise on cost estimates for re-embedding at scale.

Alya: customer also seeing latency spikes and 429s on large batch rerank jobs. Josh: capture request_ids and we can check server queueing. ask: are they on Hosted or Dedicated? Dedicated customers may have higher throughput and different quota rules.

Alya: example of headers they'd paste for 429 investigation:
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1680000000
Request-Id: req_abc123xyz
```

Josh: internal actions:
- Josh -> check model registry and confirm expected embedding_dim for rerank-quick-768-v2, attach metadata here. if validation behavior is inconsistent, open SVC-758 to make mismatched-dim handling consistent and clearer (always 400 with actionable message).
- Kai -> draft KB: "Embedding <-> Rerank compatibility" with recommended model pairings, projection tradeoffs, and the validation snippet above.
- Devon -> contact billing with invoice ids if customer shares them.
- Alya -> collect anonymized request bodies & vector samples (customer agreed to provide two examples).

support-bot: Ticket created SUP-9477 (owner: Alya).

Sam (Acme Data): thanks, we'll send two anonymized payloads and the DB keys by EOD. re-embedding millions is heavy, so we'll evaluate projection first.

Alya: marking follow-up. will post final notes & KB link here once Kai drafts it. tagging @billing-team to watch for invoice questions. :thumbsup:
